description: Paper data files larger than the 5,000,000-byte release limit (check-release REL-01, ADR-079). They are not committed (.gitignore); fetch_external.py downloads and verifies them, or the regenerate command rebuilds them. Distribution channel: the ModelScope dataset repository (ADR-201); url stays null until the file is published there.

files.name: m1geo_full.parquet
files.regenerate: export PYTHONPATH=python:research/ccf-tpci/experiments && python research/ccf-tpci/experiments/sweep.py m1geo --run-id full n=2000 chunks=5 && python research/ccf-tpci/experiments/collect.py m1geo/full
